title.zh: 修订第720号共和国法第13条（即规定农村银行的设立、组织与运营并为其他目的法案）的法案
title.en: An Act to Amend Section Thirteen of Republic Act Numbered Seven Hundred and Twenty, Entitled “An Act Providing for the Creation, Organization and Operation of Rural Banks, and for Other Purposes”
title.orig: An Act to Amend Section Thirteen of Republic Act Numbered Seven Hundred and Twenty, Entitled “An Act Providing for the Creation, Organization and Operation of Rural Banks, and for Other Purposes”

title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแก้ไขเพิ่มเติมมาตรา 13 แห่งพระราชบัญญัติแห่งสาธารณรัฐที่ 720 และเพื่อวัตถุประสงค์อื่น
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Pasal 13 Undang-Undang Republik No. 720, dan untuk tujuan lain

text.en:
Section thirteen of Republic Act Numbered Seven hundred and twenty is hereby amended by adding a new paragraph thereof, to read as follows:
"In normal times, the Central Bank may rediscount against paper evidencing a loan granted by a rural bank to any of its customers which can be liquefied within a period of two hundred and seventy days."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: September 9, 1955.
